stages.headline: A cone consists of a disc (the base) and the segments (generators) joining the vertex S to the points of the base circle; SO is its height.
stages.headlineEnglish: A cone consists of a disc (the base) and the segments (generators) joining the vertex S to the points of the base circle; SO is its height.

stages.headline: The generator, height and radius form a right triangle: l² = h² + r².
stages.headlineEnglish: The generator, height and radius form a right triangle: l² = h² + r².

stages.headline: The lateral surface of a cone unrolls into a sector of radius l with arc 2πr, so S(lateral) = πrl.
stages.headlineEnglish: The lateral surface of a cone unrolls into a sector of radius l with arc 2πr, so S(lateral) = πrl.
